title: Implement POST /api/prospects and GET /api/batches/[id]/prospects routes
description: Create API routes for bulk-creating prospects and fetching all prospects for a batch.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/prospects accepts array of prospect objects
All prospects are inserted with batch_id, slug generated from business_name
Returns 201 with array of created prospects
GET /api/batches/[id]/prospects returns all prospects for the batch

steps.details: Export POST handler. Accepts `{ batchId: string, prospects: ProspectInput[] }`. Generate slug for each: `slugify(business_name + '-' + nanoid(6))`. Bulk insert via `createProspects([])`in repository. Return 201 with created records.
Export GET handler. Call `getProspectsByBatch(id)`. Return JSON array. Include prospect status and slug.
Create `src/lib/utils/slugify.ts`. Function: `slugify(name: string): string` — lowercases, replaces spaces with hyphens, strips non-alphanumeric characters, appends 6-char nanoid for uniqueness.
POST a batch of 3 prospects. GET /api/batches/[id]/prospects and verify all 3 are returned with correct slugs.
